title: SQM Q2 2026 Form 6-K earnings release
excerpt: SQM reported Q2 net income of USD 660.0 million, lithium sales of 84.1 thousand tonnes LCE, and a Novandino realized lithium price of about USD 21.8 per kilogram.
summary: The SEC-filed Q2 release confirms stronger lithium price and volume transmission, a Salar Futuro submission, higher cash and debt, and a three-year USD 3 billion capex plan.
